limitations: Previously inspected validation; historical aliases/calibration used development labels. Full-set scalar selection is development analysis. Group bootstrap is conditional on selected parameters; no untouched-test claim. P spatial mapping matches incumbent sampler, including its padding behavior. Same head/scoring/normalization for all controls. Only local raw query is shuffled by a half-sequence roll, not a multiseed random control. No new adaptive gate.

all datasets: Anchored / Legacy median latency <= 1.05
all datasets: Anchored - Legacy peak allocated <= 50 MiB

promotion.interpretation: These development criteria select whether to replace the incumbent. They do not establish CVPR acceptance, independent-test generalization, or novelty against untested methods.

global_gain.selection: One shared g0 for all declared domains; chosen using development labels over the same four frozen gains. Equal weight per domain, not per image. This analysis does not replace frozen-reference promotion criteria or constitute untouched-test evidence.
